name: New Bough
passiveDesc:
When the equipping character hits the opponent with an attack within 12s after using the Elemental Skill, they gain the "Verdant" effect, which increases their ATK by 4/5/6/7/8% and their Elemental Mastery by 20/25/30/35/40. This effect lasts 6s and can trigger once every second. Max 3 stacks. The aforementioned effects can still trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The effect of "Verdant" is changed to: Increases ATK by 6/7.5/9/10.5/12% as well as Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by the equipping character by 8/10/12/14/16%.
description: A sword made from sacred wood, said to have once turned the tide of battle.
